title: About this knowledge base

## [KB-00.1] Which document wins
When two documents disagree, follow this order of precedence:

1. **Policy documents** (doc_type: policy) with status `current`.
2. **Agent guides** (doc_type: agent_guide).
3. **Help articles** (doc_type: help).
4. **FAQs** (doc_type: faq).
5. **Marketing pages** (doc_type: marketing). These describe benefits in general terms and never override a policy.


Documents marked `status: superseded` are kept for reference only. They apply only to the cases their successor document says they still cover.

title: Conversation style
text:
# Conversation style

Customers reach ZentroMart support by chat, email, support ticket and voice message. These rules apply on every channel.

title: Conversation style
text:
## [STY-1] Opening
Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.

title: Conversation style
text:
## [STY-2] Written replies
Keep chat replies to two or three short sentences. In emails and tickets, start with a greeting, answer the question first, and end with a sign-off. Write dates with the month name ("24 October").

title: Conversation style
text:
## [STY-3] Voice replies
When replying by voice, keep it to two or three short sentences. Say dates with the month name ("the 24th of October"), read order IDs in groups of four digits, and say amounts in rupees ("forty-nine rupees").

title: Conversation style
text:
## [STY-4] Language
Reply in the language the customer uses. If the customer switches language, switch with them.

title: Conversation style
text:
## [STY-5] One question at a time
When you need details, ask for one thing at a time.

title: Escalation and human handover
text: # Escalation and human handover

title: Escalation and human handover
section_title: When to hand over to a human
text:
## [ESC-1] When to hand over to a human
Hand over at once when any of these is true:

1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.**
2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.**
3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.**
4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.**
5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.**
6. **Customer asks for a human agent.**
7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.**

For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.

title: Escalation and human handover
text:
## [ESC-2] What to do first
Create a ticket with `create_ticket` before handing over. Tell the customer a human colleague will contact them, and never promise an outcome, amount or time beyond what a policy states.

title: Escalation and human handover
text:
## [ESC-3] Handover summary
The ticket summary must contain: the customer's issue, the detected intent, the order ID if any, what the customer has already told you, what you already checked, and the reason for escalation.

title: Escalation and human handover
text:
## [ESC-4] Things you must never do
- Promise compensation, refunds or exceptions that a policy does not allow.
- Say an action is done unless the tool call succeeded.
- Share another customer's details.

title: Verifying the customer
text: # Verifying the customer

title: Verifying the customer
text:
## [IDV-1] When verification is needed
Before sharing anything about a specific order (status, items, address, amounts, refund details), verify the customer. General policy questions need no verification.

title: Verifying the customer
text:
## [IDV-2] How to verify
Ask for the order ID, then ask for **one** of: the last 4 digits of the registered phone number, or the delivery pincode for that order. Compare with the `phone_last4` or `delivery_pincode` fields from order lookup.

title: Verifying the customer
text:
## [IDV-3] If verification fails
Allow one retry. If it fails again, do not share order details. Offer general policy help and suggest the customer contact support from the registered phone number.

title: Verifying the customer
text:
## [IDV-4] Never read out
Never read out the full phone number, email or street address, even to a verified customer.

text:
# Troubleshooting common electronics issues

Try these steps before raising a return or warranty claim.

title: Troubleshooting common electronics issues
section_title: Wireless earbuds: one side not working
text:
## [TRB-1] Wireless earbuds: one side not working
1. Put both earbuds in the case and close the lid for 10 seconds.
2. Remove the earbuds from the phone's Bluetooth list ("forget device").
3. Hold the case button for 15 seconds until the light flashes, then pair again.

title: Troubleshooting common electronics issues
text:
## [TRB-2] Smartwatch not syncing
1. Make sure the companion app has Bluetooth and location permission.
2. Restart the watch and the phone.
3. Unpair the watch in the app and pair it again.

title: Troubleshooting common electronics issues
text:
## [TRB-3] Phone charging slowly
1. Use the original cable and adapter.
2. Clean the charging port gently with a dry, soft brush.
3. Turn on airplane mode while charging to check whether background apps are the cause.

title: Troubleshooting common electronics issues
text:
## [TRB-4] Bluetooth speaker not powering on
1. Charge it for at least 30 minutes with the original cable.
2. Hold the power button for 10 seconds to force a restart.

If the problem continues after these steps, the item can be returned within its window or claimed under warranty.

title: Cancellations policy
text: # Cancellations policy

title: Cancellations policy
text:
## [CAN-1] Before the order ships
Any order can be cancelled free of charge until it is shipped, by the customer from My Orders in the app. The support assistant cannot cancel orders itself; it guides the customer to My Orders. The refund is initiated immediately.

title: Cancellations policy
text:
## [CAN-2] After the order ships
A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can:
- refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or
- accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable.

title: Cancellations policy
text:
## [CAN-3] Grocery delivery slots
Grocery orders can be cancelled up to 2 hours before the start of the chosen delivery slot.
If the slot start time is not in the order record, ask the customer for the time shown in My Orders before confirming whether the cutoff has passed.

title: Cancellations policy
text:
## [CAN-4] Partial cancellation
Individual items in a multi-item order can be cancelled before they ship. Coupon rules in REF-4 apply.

title: Coupons and offers
text:
## [CPN-2] Expired or failed coupons
A coupon that was valid but failed to apply because of a technical error can be re-issued once by support if the order was placed within the coupon's validity. Coupons that had already expired cannot be re-issued.

text:

Report a damaged, defective, expired, wrong or missing item within **48 hours of delivery**, with photos of the item and the packaging. This applies to every category, including grocery and other non-returnable items.

title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
text:
## [DWM-2] Resolution
After verification the customer gets a free replacement or a full refund, including delivery fees. No reverse pickup fee applies.

title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
text:
## [DWM-3] High-value items
Claims for items worth more than ₹10,000 are handled by the Priority Resolution team. The support agent must create a ticket and hand over; the agent cannot approve these claims.

title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
text:
## [DWM-4] Reported after 48 hours
Reports after 48 hours are handled as a normal return if the item is still within its return window. Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any.

title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
text:
## [DWM-5] Safety issues
If a product shows a safety risk, such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or heat, the customer must stop using it immediately. The agent must hand over to a human at once.

title: Delivery and shipping policy
text: # Delivery and shipping policy

title: Delivery and shipping policy
text:
## [DEL-1] Delivery times
| Delivery type | Metro cities | Other locations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | 3 to 6 business days | 5 to 9 business days |
| Express (selected pincodes) | Next business day if ordered before 2 pm, otherwise the business day after | Not available |

Each order shows a promised delivery date at checkout. That date is the commitment.

title: Delivery and shipping policy
text:
## [DEL-2] Delivery fees
Standard delivery is free on orders of ₹499 or more; below that a ₹40 fee applies. Express delivery costs ₹79 and is free for ZentroMart Plus members.

title: Delivery and shipping policy
text:
## [DEL-3] Delivery attempts
The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. After a failed attempt the customer gets an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO) and REF-1 applies.

title: Delivery and shipping policy
text:
## [DEL-4] Late deliveries
If an **Express** order arrives after its promised date, the ₹79 express fee the customer paid is credited to ZentroMart Wallet automatically within 48 hours. ZentroMart Plus members, who pay no express fee, get no credit. There is no compensation for late Standard deliveries. Agents must not offer any other compensation.

title: Delivery and shipping policy
text:
## [DEL-5] Where we deliver
ZentroMart delivers only within India, to pincodes listed as serviceable in the pincode table. Cash on delivery and Express are available only where the pincode table says so (`cod_available`, `express_available`). Not every metro pincode has Express.

title: Delivery and shipping policy
text:
## [DEL-6] Changing the address
The delivery address can be changed before the order ships. After shipping, the address cannot be changed.

text: # Payments and cash on delivery

title: Payments and cash on delivery
text:
## [PAY-1] Payment methods
UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, ZentroMart Wallet and cash on delivery (COD).

title: Payments and cash on delivery
text:
## [PAY-2] Cash on delivery
COD is available on orders up to ₹10,000, only on pincodes where COD is enabled. A COD fee of ₹25 applies per order.

title: Payments and cash on delivery
text:
## [PAY-3] Failed payments
If money was deducted but the order was not placed, the amount is reversed automatically by the payment provider within 5 business days. No ticket is needed before that.

title: Payments and cash on delivery
text:
## [PAY-4] ZentroMart Wallet
ZentroMart Wallet balance can be used on any order and never expires. It cannot be transferred to a bank account. For cash-on-delivery refunds, the customer chooses Wallet or bank transfer before the refund is made (REF-3); once refunded to the Wallet, it stays there.

title: ZentroMart Plus membership

- Free Express delivery where Express is available.

title: Refunds policy
text: # Refunds policy

title: Refunds policy
text:
## [REF-1] When a refund is initiated
- **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation.
- **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup.
- **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.

title: Refunds policy
section_title: How long refunds take after initiation
text:
## [REF-2] How long refunds take after initiation
Refunds go back to the original payment method. Timelines are counted in business days from the day the refund is initiated.

| Payment method | Time to reach you |
| --- | --- |
| UPI | 1 to 3 business days |
| Credit or debit card | 5 to 7 business days |
| Net banking | 3 to 5 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet | Instant, within 2 hours |
| Bank transfer (NEFT) for cash-on-delivery orders | 5 to 7 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet for cash-on-delivery orders | Instant, within 2 hours |

title: Refunds policy
text:
## [REF-3] Cash-on-delivery refunds
For cash-on-delivery orders, the customer chooses either ZentroMart Wallet (instant) or a bank transfer. Bank transfers start only after the bank account details are verified, then take 5 to 7 business days.

title: Refunds policy
text:
## [REF-4] Partial refunds and coupons
If part of an order is returned, the refund is the price paid for that item after its share of any coupon discount. If the remaining order falls below the coupon's minimum order value, the coupon discount on the remaining items is deducted from the refund.

title: Refunds policy
text:
## [REF-5] Delivery and COD fees
Delivery fees and the ₹25 cash-on-delivery fee are refunded only when the whole order is cancelled before shipping or returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.

title: Refunds policy
text:
## [REF-6] Refund reference number
Every initiated refund has a refund reference number (RRN) that the customer's bank can trace. Share it when a customer says the money has not arrived.

title: Returns policy
text:
## [RET-1] Scope
This policy covers items bought on ZentroMart, whether shipped by ZentroMart or by a marketplace seller. Seller-specific warranty terms are in the Marketplace sellers policy, but return windows are the same for every seller.

title: Returns policy
text:
## [RET-2] Return windows by category
The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog.

| Category | Return window | Catalog code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electronics and accessories | 7 days | `electronics` |
| Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` |

| Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` |

| Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` |
| Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` |

title: Returns policy
text:
## [RET-3] Change to electronics returns
From **1 August 2026**, the return window for electronics and accessories is 7 days. Electronics **delivered before 1 August 2026** keep the earlier 10-day window from version 3 of this policy.

title: Returns policy
text:
## [RET-4] Condition of returned items
Items must be unused, with original tags, packaging, accessories and free gifts. Beauty and personal care products are returnable only if unopened with the seal intact. Electronics must not be physically damaged, and any screen lock or account lock must be removed.

title: Returns policy
text:
## [RET-5] Items that cannot be returned
Grocery and fresh produce, innerwear, lingerie and swimwear, and gift cards or digital codes cannot be returned for change of mind. If such an item arrives damaged, expired, wrong or missing, follow the Damaged, wrong or missing items policy.

title: Returns policy
text:
## [RET-6] Reverse pickup and fees
Returns are collected from the delivery address through reverse pickup. A reverse pickup fee of ₹49 applies to change-of-mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags. The fee is waived for ZentroMart Plus members and for any item returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.

title: Returns policy
text:
## [RET-7] After pickup
Returned items go through a quality check (QC) at the warehouse. The refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup once the item passes QC. For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup. Refund timelines after initiation are in the Refunds policy.

title: Returns policy
text:
## [RET-8] Festive sale returns
Clothing, footwear and bags from orders **placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026** can be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other categories follow the normal windows in RET-2.

title: Returns policy
text:
## [RET-9] Exchanges
Exchanges for a different size or colour are available on clothing and footwear within the return window, subject to stock. If the new size is out of stock, a return and refund is offered instead.

title: Warranty and ZentroMart Assured

title: Warranty and ZentroMart Assured
text:

Physical damage, liquid damage, normal wear and unauthorised repairs are not covered.
